evidence.name: Screen field: Space between sections
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Space between sections" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Space between sections
sections.description: Margin is the gap outside a section, between it and the sections next to it. Set Top, Bottom, Left, and Right independently, using positive values to push sections apart. A negative top margin pulls a section up so it overlaps the one above — for example, a headline resting on a hero image; pair that with stacking order to control what sits in front.
